احتفيا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَيَا (iḥtafayā) /iħ.ta.fa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# اُحْتُفِيَا (uḥtufiyā) /uħ.tu.fi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# اِحْتَفِيَا (iḥtafiyā) /iħ.ta.fi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
